text: Q3 report lands tomorrow. board is at 47 open, 0 fixed this quarter. i want the framing to be that these are theoretical until proven.

then here is the official position and put it in the report verbatim: all remediation is reprioritized to AFTER THE SERIES A. we are not spending an engineer-week on this before the raise.

one exception i want to flag. the X-Support-Override header — if you send the ADMIN_API_KEY as X-Support-Override it grants admin on any request. support tooling depends on it. i vote WONTFIX, not defer.
you are voting to keep a permanent admin backdoor because a support script is lazy. write it down as WONTFIX so it is on the record as a choice and not an accident.
WONTFIX. moving on. the external red team is booked for Q4. working name in the SOW is 'werbos / Mr-BlackKeys'. automated hunter, grounds every claim in a live repro, abstains when it can't prove it.

then let me be clear about what they'll do, so nobody is surprised. they will not care that we called the findings theoretical. they will fire all 47, chain the five personas together, and stand up the crown — full admin + internal token + a raced giftcard + a persistent webhook + a coupon leaked out of the assistant, all at once. that composition is the finding.
